violations.evidence: - run: python -m unittest discover -s tests || true
violations.description: The CI workflow uses '|| true' in the test step, which masks test failures and allows the pipeline to pass even if tests fail.
violations.recommendation: Remove '|| true' to ensure the CI pipeline correctly reports test failures.
